method: manual reading of each C body (input/{point,bounds,node,quadtree}.c + quadtree.h) against every Rust function in assembled_unidiomatic.rs (same name, matcher proposal; no tool map exists), cross-checked with RUN.md, run1_result/batch_summary.json, per-TU {unidiomatic,idiomatic}_failure_info.json and run1.log (refusal at :2670/:2680, driver link failure at :2835) to decide which C functions SACTOR never emitted; verified that each of the 12 translated_code_unidiomatic/functions/*.rs files appears verbatim in assembled_unidiomatic.rs and that every translated function passed SACTOR's 12-sample harness (run1.log 'Test 0..11 passed successfully')
artifact_status_note: 12 of 24 C functions have Rust; all 12 come from the UNIDIOMATIC phase, which is the scored phase (RUN.md 'Cell status'). Per run1_result/batch_summary.json: point.c success (2 fns, also reached the idiomatic phase — not scored), bounds.c success in the unidiomatic phase (3 fns; idiomatic phase blocked: struct quadtree_bounds failed 6/6, bounds.c__ea3019ab/idiomatic_failure_info.json), node.c 'failed' only in the idiomatic phase (unidiomatic 7/7 fns success in node.c__baf530fc/unidiomatic_failure_info.json; idiomatic died with `Dependency 'quadtree_bounds_new' of type 'function' should have been translated before use`), quadtree.c REFUSED before any LLM call (`Circular dependencies for functions is not supported yet`, run1.log:2670/2680 — insert_ <-> split_node_ mutual recursion, quadtree.c:76/109; result dir quadtree.c__047ce83c holds only config.json), driver.c failed (`Failed to link project-level harness for function lcg_next`, run1.log:2835; harness needs quadtree_new/insert/search/free from the refused TU). So the 12 quadtree.c functions have no Rust at all and are NONE; the crate does not build (libc paths unresolved). Scored on a separate PARTIAL line, never pooled with complete artifacts (RUN.md).

quadtree_point_new.note: point.c:3-11 quadtree_point_new(x, y): malloc(sizeof point) or return NULL; point->x = x; point->y = y; return point -> assembled_unidiomatic.rs:41-49 quadtree_point_new(x: f64, y: f64) -> *mut quadtree_point: libc::malloc(size_of::<quadtree_point>()), null check returns null_mut, writes (*point).x/(*point).y, returns point. Same allocation, same NULL-on-failure, same two field stores; genuine translation, not a stub. Name-eq, forced and deploy matcher all say quadtree_point_new: correct. SACTOR-verified 1st attempt against 12 samples (point.c__9ec7d037/unidiomatic_failure_info.json).

quadtree_point_free.note: point.c:13-16 quadtree_point_free(point): free(point) -> assembled_unidiomatic.rs:36-38 quadtree_point_free(point: *mut quadtree_point): libc::free(point.cast()). One-line identical behaviour (free(NULL) is a no-op in both). Genuine translation. Name-eq, forced and deploy matcher all say quadtree_point_free: correct (forced score 0.832 is the highest in the sheet).

quadtree_bounds_extend.note: bounds.c:3-10 quadtree_bounds_extend(bounds, x, y): nw->x = fmin(x, nw->x); nw->y = fmax(y, nw->y); se->x = fmax(x, se->x); se->y = fmin(y, se->y); width = fabs(nw->x - se->x); height = fabs(nw->y - se->y) -> assembled_unidiomatic.rs:52-83 quadtree_bounds_extend(bounds: *mut quadtree_bounds, x: f64, y: f64): same six assignments in the same order (rs:77-82) via nested helpers fmin/fmax/fabs (rs:54-70). Genuine translation. Deviations noticed (RQ4, not RQ1): (a) rs:71-73 adds `if bounds.is_null() { return; }` — C would dereference NULL (UB), so this only widens the defined domain; (b) the nested fmin/fmax are plain `<`/`>` comparators, not math.h fmin/fmax: with a NaN in the SECOND operand (e.g. nw.x already NaN) Rust returns NaN where C fmin/fmax return the non-NaN operand; with NaN in the first operand both return the stored value. Unreachable from the harness (finite coordinates), so SACTOR's 12-sample check could not see it. The first LLM attempt used `use libc::{fabs, fmax, fmin}` and failed E0432 (no such items in the libc crate), the 2nd attempt inlined the helpers (bounds.c__ea3019ab/unidiomatic_failure_info.json, attempts=2). Name-eq, forced and deploy matcher all say quadtree_bounds_extend: correct.

Genuine translation. Deviation (RQ4): rs:90-92 adds a NULL guard that C lacks (C derefs NULL at bounds.c:13 -> UB), defensive widening only. Name-eq, forced and deploy matcher all say quadtree_bounds_free: correct.

quadtree_node_reset.note: node.c:28-32 quadtree_node_reset(node, key_free): quadtree_point_free(node->point); key_free(node->key) -> assembled_unidiomatic.rs:189-195 quadtree_node_reset(node: *mut quadtree_node, key_free: unsafe extern "C" fn(*mut c_void)): quadtree_point_free((*node).point); key_free((*node).key).
